title: MedlinePlus: MedlinePlus Connect Users and Partners
content: MedlinePlus Connect Users and Partners Below are health care organizations and electronic health record systems that have told us they are using MedlinePlus Connect . This is not a comprehensive list. Join the MedlinePlus Connect email list to keep up with developments and exchange ideas with your colleagues. This email list will be useful for health IT developers and other interested users. If your organization or system is using MedlinePlus Connect, contact us and we'll add you to this page.
